description: Get current, version-aware code and prose snippets from a library's documentation for a question (Context7). Works without a key.

api_key.description: Optional Context7 API key for higher rate limits (or set CONTEXT7_API_KEY)

library.description: Up to 4 library ids from context7_find_library, e.g. /vercel/next.js

query.description: The question or task, e.g. app router middleware redirect

name: context7_get_docs
